idea-plugin.name: Firmware Release Gate for sdkconfig and prj.conf
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the build-config lines that ship an ESP-IDF or Zephyr device with secure boot off, a debug port open, unsigned images or plaintext OTA.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Firmware Release Gate for sdkconfig and prj.conf: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 18 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/firmware-release-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/firmware-release-gate

action.text: Firmware Release Gate for sdkconfig and prj.conf: Check This File
action.description: Run Firmware Release Gate for sdkconfig and prj.conf on the file in the editor
